scope: Independent read-only review of the exact-image C/E capture driver and frozen16-window plan. No new workload or physical-device operation by reviewer; not a performance result.
verified_boundaries: C runs the exact image ELF through image libc plus precisely four original image library hashes; live mappings and before/after file identities are checked.
The mapped process executable may be the explicit image libc loader; exact C identity is separately bound to the executable mapped artifact.

Non-executable data mappings, including the read-only TZif mapping, are recorded with permissions/offset/hash independently from the strict ELF set. Unexpected executable anonymous/file mappings are rejected except vDSO.
Original frozen loadgen/upstream hashes and normalized hit configuration, seeds, rates, client counts,1000UDPprewarm+1000warmup+4000measurement are retained.
No preexisting C children after UDP prewarm; inherited fork/clone work is part of observation. Capture must end with no remaining service children after a fixed1second drain.
Strace follows every descendant and records all syscall categories; parent-only filtering is not allowed for C TCP.
Stat and sampling run separately. Stat records grouped instructions:u/instructions:k/cycles:u/cycles:k; sampling records only instructions:u with period10000.
Control ACKs bound enabled PMU windows. Observation ends at fixed grace before post-window map/hash checks.
Twelve stat windows use three alternating pairs per scene. Four sample windows use one per side/scene. This is not the frozen five-pair acceptance.
Unknown/gap/zero-size/overlapping symbol attribution remains explicit; sample share times a separately measured user-instruction total is a cross-run estimate.
